framing_note: A document-native read of TMICC's own filings — a report map and a chronological list of dated strategic checkpoints each document itself states, with page/item citations. Distinct from the Strategy tab (which back-traces commitments to initiatives) and the Timeline tab (which correlates TMICC against competitors/macro events) — this panel stays inside what a single document says, in the order it says it. Multiple documents, selectable via dropdown: TMICC itself has only ever filed ONE true Annual Report (FY2025, since it only began independent existence in Dec 2025) — the second entry here is its pre-listing SEC registration statement, the real document that carries the ice cream business's history before that, honestly labeled as what it actually is rather than mislabeled as a second 'annual report'.

documents.label: FY2025 Annual Report (Form 20-F)

source_document.title: The Magnum Ice Cream Company N.V. — Annual Report 2025
source_document.filing_type: Form 20-F (Annual Report), filed with the U.S. SEC — the SEC's annual-report equivalent for a foreign private issuer. TMICC is Netherlands-incorporated and listed on NYSE, LSE, and Euronext Amsterdam, so it files a 20-F rather than a US-domestic 10-K; functionally the same disclosure role, which is why this panel is framed as a 10-K-style analyzer.
source_document.checked_for_newer_reports: Checked TMICC's investor relations site (corporate.magnumicecream.com/en/investors) and SEC EDGAR, 22 Sep 2026 — this FY2025 report remains the current, latest Annual Report; the FY2026 Annual Report isn't expected until early 2027. Two 2026 Form 6-K filings exist (interim/current disclosures, e.g. AGM results) but are not yet incorporated into this panel — gap, revisit next refresh.

strategic_checkpoints.detail: Three levers named explicitly: supply chain transformation, overhead reduction, and technology-enabled operations. Designed to deliver savings over the medium term.
strategic_checkpoints.cross_reference: Strategy tab — headline commitment 'Cost / separation savings'

strategic_checkpoints.checkpoint: Demerger from Unilever completed; TMICC began trading as an independent listed company
strategic_checkpoints.detail: Described in both the Board Chair and CEO updates as the defining milestone of the year.

strategic_checkpoints.checkpoint: €3 billion debut bond issuance across four tranches (2029, 2031, 2034, 2037)
strategic_checkpoints.detail: Euro Medium Term Note programme, interest rate range 2.75%-4%, order book oversubscribed more than 7x. Financial liabilities rose to €3,416m (2024: €333m); average debt maturity 7.5 years. This is TMICC's real debt-maturity wall — worth tracking against future refinancing risk.

strategic_checkpoints.checkpoint: €300 million credit facility earmarked for the Indian ice cream business acquisition
strategic_checkpoints.detail: Financing detail behind the Kwality Wall's transaction (completed 30 Mar 2026, already tracked in the Ecosystem tab) — this is the specific facility funding it, not previously captured.

strategic_checkpoints.checkpoint: Full compliance with the 2025 Dutch Corporate Governance Code, Best Practice Provision 1.4.3(ii)-(iv)
strategic_checkpoints.detail: TMICC's own Board states it is not yet fully compliant as a newly-standalone company, and expects to close the gap by 2026. A real, self-disclosed governance checkpoint distinct from the Foundation Plan for Growth shareholder-dissent issue tracked elsewhere.

strategic_checkpoints.checkpoint: Exit all remaining Transitional Services Agreements (TSAs) with Unilever
strategic_checkpoints.detail: TMICC still relies on Unilever for some transitional operational support post-demerger; full independence from these arrangements is targeted for end-2027.

strategic_checkpoints.checkpoint: Vanilla for Change programme — 80% of enrolled Madagascar farmers transitioned to regenerative agriculture; 1 million trees planted (up from 585,000 today), survival rate target rising from 40% to 65%
strategic_checkpoints.detail: Run with Symrise and Save the Children in the vanilla-producing Sava region of Madagascar.

strategic_checkpoints.checkpoint: New cabinet energy-efficiency technology begins rolling out on new freezer-cabinet purchases
strategic_checkpoints.detail: Connects directly to the freezer-cabinet fleet risk already flagged in the Ecosystem tab (TMICC's largest single emissions source, and a fleet it doesn't own).

strategic_checkpoints.checkpoint: Net Zero ambition across Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions
strategic_checkpoints.detail: Explicit scenario-planning horizons defined elsewhere in the report: near-term 2026-2030, medium-term 2031-2039 for climate transition-risk modelling.

clarifications.topic: "Potential acquisition in India" in the report's cautionary statement (p.235)
clarifications.clarification: This appears only inside the standard forward-looking-statements disclaimer boilerplate (a list of example statement categories), not as a fresh, separate disclosure. Read in context, it most plausibly refers to the already-known Kwality Wall's transaction rather than signalling a second, undisclosed India deal — flagged here so it isn't mistaken for new news.

documents.label: Pre-listing Registration Statement (Form 20FR12B, 2025)

source_document.title: The Magnum Ice Cream Company B.V. — Form 20FR12B Registration Statement
source_document.filing_type: Form 20FR12B — a registration statement, NOT an annual report. Filed with the SEC ahead of TMICC's Dec 2025 listing to register its shares. Included here because it's the real document carrying the ice cream business's multi-year history before TMICC existed as a standalone filer — TMICC itself has only ever published one true Annual Report (see the FY2025 entry).
source_document.fiscal_year_covered: Combined carve-out financial statements for the three years ended 31 December 2024 (the Ice Cream Business's stand-alone financial position/results/cash flow, carved out of Unilever's own consolidated accounts)
source_document.checked_for_newer_reports: This is the initial 20FR12B; two DRS/A (draft registration statement, amended) versions preceded it in the SEC's filing history but aren't separately analyzed here — the filed 20FR12B supersedes them.

strategic_checkpoints.checkpoint: Principal reorganisation date — the ice cream business's internal corporate restructuring within Unilever, ahead of the demerger
strategic_checkpoints.detail: The base date the reorganisation into a standalone group is anchored to.

strategic_checkpoints.checkpoint: India demerger expected to become effective
strategic_checkpoints.detail: Quoted directly: "expected to become effective by January 2026 and Kwality Wall's India is expected to start trading...by April 2026." India was a Deferred Territory — not part of the main December 2025 demerger, following its own separate timeline.
strategic_checkpoints.cross_reference: Ecosystem/Strategy tabs — Kwality Wall's completed 30 Mar 2026, close to but not exactly matching this original expected date

strategic_checkpoints.checkpoint: Kwality Wall's India expected to start trading as part of TMICC
strategic_checkpoints.detail: Same Deferred Territories disclosure as above — India's demerger effectiveness and trading start were planned as two separate, sequential milestones.

strategic_checkpoints.checkpoint: Portugal demerger expected to become effective
strategic_checkpoints.detail: Quoted directly: "expected to become effective by the first quarter of 2026." Portugal was the other named Deferred Territory alongside India.

strategic_checkpoints.date: Within 3 years of the share sale
strategic_checkpoints.detail: A longer completion runway than the demerger-effectiveness date itself — the two are distinct milestones for the same territory.

strategic_checkpoints.checkpoint: Transitional Period end — the outer boundary for Transitional Services Agreements (TSAs) with Unilever
strategic_checkpoints.detail: Consistent with the FY2025 Annual Report's own "exit all TSAs by end of 2027" checkpoint — this document is the earlier, more precisely-dated version of the same commitment.
strategic_checkpoints.cross_reference: FY2025 Annual Report entry — TSA exit by end of 2027

strategic_checkpoints.checkpoint: Pro forma capitalisation at listing: €587m cash, €4,049m total indebtedness, €2,143m share capital
strategic_checkpoints.detail: The balance-sheet snapshot used to size TMICC's opening capital structure ahead of listing — a useful baseline to compare against the FY2025 Annual Report's actual post-listing figures (€3,416m financial liabilities at FY2025 year-end).

clarifications.topic: This is not a second Annual Report
clarifications.clarification: TMICC has filed exactly one Annual Report to date (FY2025). This registration statement predates that — it's the prospectus-style document used to register TMICC's shares ahead of listing, built on combined carve-out financials rather than a standalone company's own consolidated accounts. Included here for real historical depth, not to imply TMICC has multiple annual reports.
